_style: Photorealistic architectural rendering in the style of a luxury condominium developer's marketing render, West Palm Beach, Florida. Golden-hour sunset with a warm pink and orange sky, soft reflections, lush tropical landscaping with royal palms and manicured hedges. Eye-level three-quarter view. Ultra-detailed, high-end real estate marketing image. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no people in focus.
_waterfront: The tower stands on Flagler Drive facing the calm Intracoastal Waterway, which fills the foreground.
_street: The building stands on a palm-lined inland city street with wide sidewalks. Inland setting: no waterfront, no marina, no lake and no open water anywhere in view.
bristol: A 25-story residential tower with a sweeping organic curved form, widest in the middle and tapering toward the top. Continuous white curved concrete floor slabs and balcony edges ripple in soft waves across the facade, with floor-to-ceiling blue-green glass between them. A low white podium with a glass lobby at its base.
trianon: A 19-story white 1970s modernist condominium shaped like a shallow crescent: a concave central section with a fine grid of recessed balconies, flanked by two flat white wings with crisp horizontal floor bands; the right wing is the tallest. A surface parking area with palms in front.
placido-mar: A 26-story 1970s white condominium made of two plain, tall white rectangular slabs side by side, the right slab taller than the left, joined by a slightly recessed core with horizontal balconies. Minimal ornament, smooth white stucco, a tall hedge and wall along the street.
la-clara: A slender 25-story contemporary glass condominium tower with softly rounded corners, light blue floor-to-ceiling glass and thin white horizontal slab edges at every floor with glass balcony railings, next to a lower white mid-rise building.
two-city-plaza: A 21-story Mediterranean Revival condominium tower in cream and pale yellow stucco: a tall arched arcade at street level with dark awnings, pilasters running up the facade, stacked balconies with black wrought-iron railings, arched windows on the upper floors and a decorative cornice at the roofline.
palm-beach-house: A 28-story white 1970s residential slab tower with long dark horizontal window bands, a vertical stack of corner balconies on one side and a slightly lower second wing beside it.
rapallo-south: An 18-story white 1970s condominium tower with a dense regular grid of windows and small balconies, part of a cluster of similar white towers, with a landscaped entrance drive and clipped hedges.
plaza-of-the-palm-beaches: A pair of matching 32-story white 1980s condominium towers side by side, with continuous horizontal bands of white balconies and dark ribbon windows, rounded corners and a landscaped podium between them.
esplanade-grande: A 15-story boutique Mediterranean-style condominium tower in warm cream stucco with arched windows, stone-colored trim, wrought-iron balconies and a red-tile accent at the roofline, rising above a low open-air amphitheater plaza.
101-lofts: A five-story cream Mediterranean loft building on a corner, with arched ground-floor storefront openings, tall loft windows, small wrought-iron balconies and a terracotta roof edge.
strand: A 15-story cream-and-white Mediterranean Revival condominium tower with stacked balconies, an arched entrance with a dark canopy, ground-floor retail and a decorative cornice.
610-clematis: An eight-story cream Mediterranean condominium built around a courtyard, with a white column arcade and green fabric awnings at street level, balconies with railings and terracotta trim.
city-palms: A ten-story pale-yellow Mediterranean condominium with a ground-floor arcade, stacked balconies, white trim and a tiled roofline.
prado: An eight-story Mediterranean-style condominium in cream and coral stucco around a palm-filled entry courtyard with a fountain, balconies and arched openings.
metropolitan: An eight-story beige stucco courtyard condominium with balconies, white trim and ground-floor storefronts.
one-city-plaza: A 16-story cream Mediterranean Revival condominium with an arched base, pilasters, stacked balconies with black iron railings, arched upper windows and a cornice.
cityplace-south-tower: A 20-story beige and tan stucco residential tower with stacked balconies, a cornice crown and a ground-floor retail base.
tower-condominium-at-cityplace: A 12-story Mediterranean residential tower in warm terracotta and cream stucco with arched windows, balconies and a tiled crown, facing a palm-lined lawn.
courtyards-in-cityplace: Five-story pale-yellow Mediterranean condominium buildings around landscaped courtyards, with balconies, white trim and pitched tile roofs.
waterview-towers: A white 1980s high-rise with continuous horizontal balcony bands and dark glass, between a waterfront boulevard and a marina full of boats.
slade: A 16-story contemporary blue-glass condominium with curved glass balconies and white slab edges, a modern white podium and a palm-lined drive.
flagler-pointe: A nine-story white U-shaped condominium with horizontal balconies wrapping a pool courtyard, beside a taller white residential tower.
portofino: A 10-story white 1960s modernist condominium tower with horizontal balcony bands and dark window strips.
flagler-landing: A group of four-story cream and white low-rise condominium buildings with balconies, pitched roofs and palm-lined walkways.
washington-tower: A 20-story white 1970s slab tower with horizontal balcony bands, set among lawns, golf greens and palm trees in a gated community.
envoy-tower: A 20-story white 1980s slab tower with balcony bands and dark windows, set among lawns and palm trees in a gated community.
forte-on-flagler: A slender 25-story contemporary tower of blue-green glass with gently curved corners and thin white slab edges.
rapallo-north: An 18-story white 1970s condominium tower with a dense grid of windows and small balconies, next to a sister tower, with a landscaped entrance drive.
flagler-yacht-club: A small four-story white boutique condominium with deep balconies and a private marina with yachts in front.
viking-arms: A three-story white low-rise condominium with long balconies and a pool, surrounded by palms.
